papers.title: Active Model Aggregation via Stochastic Mirror Descent
papers.abstract: We consider the problem of learning convex aggregation of models, that is as good as the best convex aggregation, for the binary classification problem. Working in the stream based active learning setting, where the active learner has to make a decision on-the-fly, if it wants to query for the label of the point currently seen in the stream, we propose a stochastic-mirror descent algorithm, called SMD-AMA, with entropy regularization. We establish an excess risk bounds for the loss of the convex aggregate returned by SMD-AMA to be of the order of $O\left(\sqrt{\frac{\log(M)}{T^{1-μ}}}\right)$, where $μ\in [0,1)$ is an algorithm dependent parameter, that trades-off the number of labels queried, and excess risk.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究主动学习中的凸聚合模型，完全不涉及有限元分析或代理建模。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on theoretical active learning for binary classification, with no application to finite element simulation, surrogate modeling, or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 在主动学习框架下学习凸聚合模型以降低标签查询。
summary_zh.method: 采用带熵正则化的随机镜像下降算法。
summary_zh.result: 推导了超额风险界，权衡查询次数与精度。

summary_en.motivation: To learn a convex aggregation of models in a stream-based active learning setting while minimizing label queries.
summary_en.method: Proposes SMD-AMA, a stochastic mirror descent algorithm with entropy regularization.
summary_en.result: Establishes excess risk bounds of order O(sqrt(log(M)/T^(1-μ))), trading off queries and accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical analysis only, no empirical validation.

papers.title: Robust Bayesian compressive sensing with data loss recovery for structural health monitoring signals
papers.abstract: The application of compressive sensing (CS) to structural health monitoring is an emerging research topic. The basic idea in CS is to use a specially-designed wireless sensor to sample signals that are sparse in some basis (e.g. wavelet basis) directly in a compressed form, and then to reconstruct (decompress) these signals accurately using some inversion algorithm after transmission to a central processing unit. However, most signals in structural health monitoring are only approximately sparse, i.e. only a relatively small number of the signal coefficients in some basis are significant, but the other coefficients are usually not exactly zero. In this case, perfect reconstruction from compressed measurements is not expected. A new Bayesian CS algorithm is proposed in which robust treatment of the uncertain parameters is explored, including integration over the prediction-error precision parameter to remove it as a "nuisance" parameter. The performance of the new CS algorithm is investigated using compressed data from accelerometers installed on a space-frame structure and on a cable-stayed bridge. Compared with other state-of-the-art CS methods including our previously-published Bayesian method which uses MAP (maximum a posteriori) estimation of the prediction-error precision parameter, the new algorithm shows superior performance in reconstruction robustness and posterior uncertainty quantification. Furthermore, our method can be utilized for recovery of lost data during wireless transmission, regardless of the level of sparseness in the signal.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文与代理模型和FEA无关，主要研究结构健康监测中的压缩感知信号重建。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on compressive sensing for structural health monitoring signals, with no connection to finite element surrogate modeling, sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or biomechanics implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高结构健康监测中压缩感知信号重建的鲁棒性和不确定性量化
summary_zh.method: 提出一种鲁棒贝叶斯压缩感知算法，对预测误差精度参数进行边缘化处理
summary_zh.result: 新算法在重建鲁棒性和后验不确定性量化方面优于现有方法，可恢复丢失数据
summary_zh.validation: 使用空间框架结构和斜拉桥的加速度计数据验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve robustness and uncertainty quantification in compressive sensing reconstruction for structural health monitoring signals.
summary_en.method: A robust Bayesian compressive sensing algorithm is proposed that integrates over the prediction-error precision parameter as a nuisance parameter.
summary_en.result: The proposed algorithm demonstrates superior reconstruction robustness and posterior uncertainty quantification compared to state-of-the-art methods, and can recover lost data.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using accelerometer data from a space-frame structure and a cable-stayed bridge.

papers.title: The Effect of Stem Length on Strain and Micromotion in the Proximal Femur Following Total Hip Arthroplasty

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究股骨柄长度对近端股骨应变和微动的影响，与用户方向高度相关。
llm.why_not_core: No experimental validation, no patient-specific geometry, and no comparison with intact femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究股骨柄长度对全髋关节置换术后近端股骨应变和微动的影响。
summary_zh.method: 使用有限元分析比较不同长度股骨柄的应变和微动分布。
summary_zh.result: 短柄设计可减少应力遮挡但增加微动，长柄则相反。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，仅基于有限元模拟。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of femoral stem length on proximal femur strain and micromotion after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Finite element analysis was used to compare strain and micromotion distributions for stems of varying lengths.
summary_en.result: Short stems reduce stress shielding but increase micromotion, while long stems show the opposite trend.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; purely computational simulation.

papers.title: Using active learning techniques to engage academic librarians in research data management
papers.venue: ResearchWorks at the University of Washington (University of Washington)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论学术图书馆员的研究数据管理，与有限元代理建模或生物力学设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is about library science and research data management, not about surrogate modeling, finite element analysis, or biomedical implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索主动学习在学术图书馆员研究数据管理中的应用。
summary_zh.method: 采用主动学习技术进行数据管理培训。
summary_zh.result: 未提供具体结果，仅为海报摘要。

summary_en.motivation: This work explores the use of active learning techniques to engage academic librarians in research data management.
summary_en.method: Active learning strategies are applied to train librarians in data management practices.
summary_en.result: No specific results are reported; this is a poster abstract.
